Turnover is half the sum of absolute weight changes over the week. The estimated flow is Δshares × NAV summed over the days with share counts, in CAD; it ignores distributions and in-kind activity, and a dash means no estimate was possible. “New in window” funds have no portfolio at the start of the week; “no change data” funds have a single snapshot.
